core: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA and organic acid catabolism
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism and B-vitamin cofactor supply
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial beta-oxidation, ketone bodies, branched-chain amino acid and propionyl-CoA catabolism, PDH/OGDH and the TCA cycle together with the cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin, biotin, pantothenate/CoA and lipoate cofactors these dehydrogenases and carboxylases need, distinguishing it from folate/methionine one-carbon, peroxisomal oxidation and choline confusables.

core: Endothelial cell specification and vessel morphogenesis
name: Endothelial cell specification and Tie2-mediated vessel maturation
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation and vessel maturation including Tie2, neuropilin and adherens-junction control, which separates it from BMP/Nodal-driven vascular and cardiac confusables and from the VEGFR2-centred confusable.

name: Insulin-like growth factor response and bone mineralization
rationale: Members combine IGF/peptide hormone responses with chondrocyte development and bone mineralization during maturation, lacking the osteoclast, osteoblast-proliferation and sphingolipid members of the confusables.

name: cGAS-STING and IRF3-driven type I interferon induction
rationale: Members concern cytosolic DNA sensing via cGAS-STING/TREX1 and IRF3-mediated IFN-beta/alpha production with its negative regulation, distinguishing it from endosomal TLR7/8/9, broad interferon-stimulated-gene and chemokine confusables.

name: TNFR1 signaling to NF-kappa-B and apoptosis
rationale: All three members are TNFR1 signaling branches, which separates them from the TRAIL/caspase-8, necroptosis and generic NF-kappa-B confusables.

name: Telomere maintenance via telomerase, C-strand replication and capping
rationale: Members cover telomerase assembly and Cajal-body trafficking, telomeric C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination and end protection, distinguishing it from general DNA repair, chromatin and rRNA/snoRNA processing confusables.

core: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members share scavenger-receptor and efferocytic clearance with lysosomal handling, and uniquely add hyaluronan degradation, AGE receptor signaling and lysosome organization, lacking the microglial, amyloid and oxidized-LDL/foam-cell members of the confusables.

core: Rho-family cytoskeletal remodeling of filopodia and cell shape
name: Rnd/RhoF GTPase and semaphorin-plexin cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members concern filopodium and cell-shape control by Rnd1-3 and RhoF GTPase cycles downstream of semaphorin-plexin and EphB, distinguishing it from cytokinesis, ephrin/RAC repulsion and dendrite-arborization confusables.

name: Valine catabolism and mitochondrial toxic metabolite repair
rationale: Members are valine-pathway enzyme deficiencies (HIBCH, ECHS1) and mitochondrial metabolite repair such as 2-hydroxyglutarate interconversion, distinct from leucine/isoleucine catabolism and BCKDH/lipoylation confusables.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
name: GABA and glutamate transport, reuptake and metabolism
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis/degradation/reuptake, glutamate and aspartate transporters, astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling and vesicular loading, lacking the glycinergic and cholinergic members of the confusables.

name: G1/S cell-cycle transcription by E2F and DREAM repressors
rationale: Members center on E2F-driven G1/S gene transcription, its repression by DREAM/p107/p130 and E2F6, and proliferation modules of stimulated T cells, lacking the DNA replication initiation and G2/M members of the confusables.

qualifier: stress-induced, with suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis
name: Stress-induced senescence and suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis
rationale: Members combine oxidative/stress-induced premature senescence and SASP with negative regulation of p53-mediated DNA-damage apoptosis, distinguishing it from oncogene-induced senescence/SAHF and pro-apoptotic p53 confusables.

name: Neural plate patterning and hindbrain segmentation
rationale: Members cover neural plate and border specification, dorsoventral axis, and hindbrain rhombomere/anterior HOX and midbrain-hindbrain boundary development, separating it from axial mesoderm/floor plate, somitogenesis, limb and forebrain confusables.

name: Osteoclast formation by macrophage fusion and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members promote osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, cell fusion and bone resorption with DAP12 signaling, lacking the M-CSF signaling and negative bone-remodeling members of the confusables.

name: Shared NK and T lymphocyte expression signatures
rationale: All members are NK- and T-cell enriched expression modules, distinguishing it from confusables built on NK cytotoxicity regulation, KIR and MHC class Ib recognition.

name: Pyroptosis via caspase-4/5 and AIM2/NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: Members concern bacterial detection, GBP defense and pyroptotic death via caspase-4/5, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, lacking the NLRP1/NLRP3 and IL-1/IL-18 processing members of the confusables.

name: Cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptor and SMAD signaling
rationale: Seven of eight members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 (plus TCF7L2 mutants), distinguishing it from Hippo/YAP, RUNX3, mismatch-repair and TGFBR3/activin confusables.

qualifier: Fc-epsilon, Fc-gamma and B cell receptors
name: Fc-epsilon, Fc-gamma and B cell receptor signaling
rationale: Members span FcERI-driven mast cell activation, FcGR phagocytosis/ADCC and BCR signaling with their inhibitory regulation, combining what the confusables split and lacking their Th2/eosinophil, B cell development and neutrophil members.

name: STAT5-activating hematopoietic cytokine and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO and TPO receptor signaling to STAT5 plus FLT3 and oncogenic kinase fusions, distinguishing it from IL-6/gp130-STAT3 and GH/prolactin confusables.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase activation and CREB phosphorylation
name: Adenylate cyclase-driven cAMP-PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation
rationale: Members concern GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis, PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation, lacking the PDE-mediated cAMP catabolism and CaMK-CREB members of the confusables.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long- and branched-chain fatty acids
rationale: Members cover acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of VLCFA and pristanoyl-CoA, ABCD1, TYSND1 and peroxisome fission with medium-chain products, lacking the alpha-oxidation, ether-lipid and fatty acid elongation members of the confusables.

qualifier: GPCR to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
name: Platelet GPCR signaling to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members are ADP, thromboxane, thrombin and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho, Rap1 and integrin-cytoskeleton linkage, lacking the degranulation, VWF/GPVI adhesion and ERK5/MAPK members of the confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism and selenocysteine incorporation
rationale: Members cover conversion and excretion of dietary selenium compounds plus selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough, distinguishing it from sulfur amino acid, methionine and ROS-detoxification confusables.

name: SLIT-ROBO repulsion in commissural and retinal axon guidance
rationale: Members concern SLIT-ROBO signaling and its expression in midline commissural and retinal ganglion cell axon guidance, lacking the netrin/ephrin/L1, RAC/ABL and broader monoaminergic guidance members of the confusables.

name: G protein-mediated presynaptic inhibition of neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members concern presynaptic inhibition via Gi/o-coupled glutamate/GABA receptors, Gbeta-gamma block of calcium channels, GIRK activation and kainate receptors, lacking the positive release, short-term potentiation and inhibitory-synapse assembly members of the confusables.
